summary: Multi-user WebRTC video call and screen sharing functionality testing complete. All 10 backend WebSocket tests passed. Frontend Meeting Room UI verified with all control buttons present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-user WebRTC signaling fully tested with 3 users. All WebSocket message types working: user_joined, user_left, chat, offer, answer, ice_candidate, state_update, raise_hand. Screen sharing state broadcasts correctly.

multi_user_websocket_connections.test: 3 users (Host, Guest1, Guest2) in same meeting

chat_message_broadcast.test: Chat messages broadcast to all 3 users

audio_video_state_updates.test: Mute/unmute state broadcast to all participants

screen_sharing_state_broadcast.test: Screen sharing start/stop broadcast to all

user_leave_notification.test: User leave notification broadcast to remaining participants

meeting_room_ui_controls.test: All control buttons visible in Meeting Room

mocked_apis_list: Camera/microphone in headless browser (expected permission error)

notes: WebSocket URL format: wss://host/api/karau-meet/ws/{meeting_id}?token=xxx&user_name=xxx. State updates use 'state_update' message type with 'state' object containing audio_enabled, video_enabled, screen_sharing, hand_raised.
